title: Press to Gather - Configurable
author: Tic0311 and CamilleBC
summary: Hold RB / R1 to gather nearby harvestable plants and resources, or press O on your keyboard. Set the distance from 10 to 200 m in Mod Settings, in 10 m steps; default 20 m. Supports Framecore UE4SS Performance mode.

file.name: Press to Gather - Configurable
file.description: Hold RB / R1 for 0.6 seconds or press O to gather nearby resources. Default 20 m; configure 10–200 m in 10 m steps using the optional Mod Setting Menu or settings.ini. Supports Framecore UE4SS Performance mode.
